manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
description:
Activate a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Earthcraft three times by tapping two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens and Prossh, untapping a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.
